{%- set system_message = '' -%}

{%- if messages[0]['role'] == 'system' -%}
  {%- set lang_pair = messages[0]['content'] | trim -%}
  {%- set messages = messages[1:] -%}
  {%- if lang_pair in language_pairs -%}
    {%- set source_lang = language_pairs[lang_pair]['source'] -%}
    {%- set target_lang = language_pairs[lang_pair]['target'] -%}
    {%- set system_message = 'You are an expert at translating text from ' + source_lang + ' to ' + target_lang + '.' -%}
  {%- else -%}
    {%- set system_message = lang_pair -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endif -%}

{%- if system_message -%}
  {{- '<s>System\n' + system_message + '</s>\n' -}}
{%- endif -%}

{%- for message in messages -%}
  {%- if (message['role'] in ['user']) != (loop.index0 % 2 == 0) -%}
    {{- raise_exception('Conversation roles must alternate between user and assistant') -}}
  {%- elif message['role'] == 'user' -%}
    {{- '<s>User\n' + message['content'] | trim + '</s>\n' -}}
  {%- elif message['role'] == 'assistant' -%}
    {{- '<s>Assistant\n' + message['content'] | trim + '</s>\n' -}}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}

{%- if add_generation_prompt -%}
  {{ '<s>Assistant\n' }}
{%- endif -%}
renderedPrompt:
<s>System
You are an expert at translating text from English to Arabic.</s>
<s>User
The meeting starts at nine.</s>
<s>Assistant
interpretation: The Jinja source contains a quoted backslash-n escape; Jinja renders actual U+000A newlines. The previous native literal backslash-n envelope did not match this publisher template. Only the fixed envelope is parsed as special tokens; instruction and user text remain literal.
